name: ArenaDesk-os
description: ArenaDesk OS - The Operating System for Gaming Cafés & Esports Venues

scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint && cd ../backend && npm run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd frontend && npm run typecheck && cd ../backend && npm run typecheck
